title: Capacity-one expected LRU misses equal 1 + N - sum(n_i^2)/N
author: research-lead (model-assisted)
model_assumptions: The trace is a uniformly random distinct permutation of a fixed multiset with counts n_i and total N.
Every distinct label sequence is equally likely; equal labels are indistinguishable.
The cache is ideal LRU with capacity exactly one and starts empty.
M counts compulsory misses, including the first access.
No prefetching, associativity, bandwidth or hardware replacement is modelled.
proof_notes: Elementary first-moment calculation by linearity over adjacent label-change indicators; complete derivation in proof.md. It has not been independently reviewed and the classical prior-art reference has not yet been recorded.
numerical_checks: All count vectors with at most three labels and seven accesses were enumerated; the formula matched the exact DP and brute force on every vector.
prior_art: Expected runs in a random word with fixed letter frequencies is a classical runs statistic; this record claims no novelty.
unresolved_obligations: Obtain independent review of the derivation.
Record a precise primary reference for the classical runs formula.

review.notes: No independent or human review yet.

limitations: Ideal LRU capacity one only; no hardware or compiler measurement.
The formula concerns random words, not real program access orders.
No compiler cost model follows from this result.
next_action: Request independent review and literature confirmation; keep this as a mathematical baseline, not an LLVM predictor.
